content.comment_body: Hello. Is there a way to prevent operators from modifying [product_name] parameters on the [product_name] operator device? For instance, if I set a password to protect the controller program, will that password also be required to change parameters on the panel?
Hi, You should open your program and look for blocks with adjustable parameters, such as timers and counters. For each, you can select 'Protection Active' to secure them.

I've tried enabling protection, but that just hides the parameter on the operator device. What I really need is for parameters to remain visible, but for editing to be restricted—so they can only be changed by authorized users.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want detailed access control for parameter management on operator devices—specifically, the ability to make parameters viewable but editable only by authorized personnel. Existing methods either completely hide parameters or let anyone edit them, which doesn't meet the specific needs for secure field operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect parameters on operator devices to remain visible to all operators, but want writing or modification privileges to be limited to authorized users, ideally managed with password protection.
